answer: Resist sybils with a pigment-marked canyon tollgate. First, each newcomer pays a 150 POA toll and receives a passage token tied to its key. Second, it must complete 25 verified deliveries across a 14-day crossing, each countersigned by a gatekeeper on the far side. Third, every crossing leaves a mark in a public registry, and a duplicate triggers a ripple audit that freezes the batch and burns the toll. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 250,000 verified deliveries and 1,500,000 POA in tolls, over $6 million. Like a canyon that admits one traveler at a time, the gate turns a flood into a queue.
